title: Remove blur-to-reveal effect; automate Pages deploy via Actions
body:
Several workshop widgets intentionally blurred their content behind a click-to-reveal interaction, useful during the live presentation but an obstacle for readers using the site as reference material. This makes all content visible immediately and adds CI-based deployment so the updated site can be published. ## Changes - **JSX (6 widgets: `agent-maturity`, `agents-md`, `common-failures`, `prompting-techniques`, `security-permissions`, `spec-driven-development`)** - `RevealSurface` no longer renders the overlay reveal button or gates content; dropped `isRevealed`/`onReveal` props, `is-revealed` class toggle, and `aria-hidden` flip. - Removed now-dead reveal state (`revealedIds`, `revealedLookup`, `handleReveal`, `handleReset`), the "Reset cards" toolbar, and unused `useMemo`/`useState` imports. - Updated hero copy that instructed users to "click a pane to reveal". - **CSS (same 6 stylesheets)** - Deleted the `filter: blur(9px)` rule, `__reveal-button` styles, `__reset-button`/`__toolbar` rules, and the reveal transition on `__reveal-content`. - Decorative SVG glow blurs (`feGaussianBlur` in `llm-agent-harness`, `survey-insights`) untouched. Before: ```css .ptw__reveal-surface:not(.is-revealed) .ptw__reveal-content { filter: blur(9px); opacity: 0.65; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; } ``` After: content renders plainly — the wrapper is now just: ```jsx
{children}
``` - **Deployment** - Added `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: builds `dist/` and publishes to the `gh-pages` branch (the repo's Pages source) on push to `main` and via manual `workflow_dispatch`. Replaces the manual `npm run deploy` step so merging this PR publishes the un-blurred site automatically.
